description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'CacheConfig' responsible for setting up caching mechanisms in the Fineract project. It configures cache managers, scans for cache annotations, and dynamically creates cache configurations using Ehcache and JCache APIs.

classes.name: CacheConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up cache management, including cache creation, scanning for cache annotations, and cache configuration generation.

methods.name: defaultCacheManager
methods.description: Creates a TransactionBoundCacheManager with a specified delegate cache manager and supported caches.

methods.name: ehCacheManager
methods.description: Initializes and returns a JCacheCacheManager with internal Ehcache configuration.

methods.name: getInternalEhCacheManager
methods.description: Builds and configures the internal Ehcache CacheManager, scans for cache annotations, and registers caches accordingly.

methods.name: generateCustomCacheConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a cache configuration based on custom templates or defaults, for a specific cache identifier.

methods.name: generateCacheConfiguration
methods.description: Generates a default cache configuration with specified max entries and TTL using Ehcache builder.
